request.prompt: A narrow cobblestone street in a small Mediterranean town during a chaotic festival run: four cartoon runners with selfie sticks sprinting toward the camera in panic, one crashing into a fruit stall with oranges flying, laundry lines across the street, barrels and a lamppost as obstacles, a massive dark red cartoon bull charging close behind them in a dust cloud, dense rows of charming yellow houses with turquoise shutters and balconies on both sides, strong midday sun. Runners in caricature stylization: exaggerated proportions, big nose, strong chin, big expressive eyes and mouth, slightly simplified shapes, like a character from a polished animated comedy film. Stylized low-poly 3D render, soft rounded shapes, flat shading with two or three light steps, no photo textures, warm sunny palette: ochre, sand, terracotta and cream walls, turquoise and blue shutters, deep blue sky, dark cobblestones with warm highlights, deep blue shadows. Polished, juicy, cartoon-like but elegant, like a high-end animated film about a Mediterranean resort town. No text, no UI. Camera: low third-person view at head height looking up the street toward the bull.
request.name: street-gameplay-01
